title: Bad Times AI (badtimesai.cc) turns 1 photo (person or pet) into a quarrel / lip-sync dance short
excerpt: 分享创造 - @boisy - Hi all, I just put my independent fan tool on its own domain and would love some feedback.Produc
content_html:
Hi all, I just put my independent fan tool on its own domain and would love some feedback.

Product: Bad Times AI Site: https://badtimesai.cc GitHub Pages: https://xianyu110.github.io/bad-times-ai/

What it does:

  • Upload 1 clear photo (a person 18+, or a pet)
  • Get a vertical 9:16 quarrel / lip-sync dance short, about 15 seconds
  • Comes with original AI ambient audio (no ripped commercial songs)
  • Person and pet templates
  • 480p / 720p, one-time credit packs, no subscription · Single $8.88 ≈ 1×720p · Popular $16.99 ≈ 3×720p · Creator $39.90 ≈ 10×720p

Disclaimer:

  • Independent fan tool, not affiliated with Imael Angel, the BAD TIMES song, badtimesai.com/.org, or any TikTok creator
  • We don't claim rights to any song
  • Person template is 18+ only; no celebrities, unauthorized faces, or NSFW

Feedback welcome:

  1. Do the landing page and samples make the "quarrel dance" idea clear right away?
  2. Are the credit packs priced right?
  3. What scenes should I add next (more pet poses, two-person quarrels)?
